name: groundline
description: Improve Codex behavior from scoped conversation feedback and actual follow-up.

interface.shortDescription: Improve Codex from conversation feedback and follow-up.
interface.longDescription: GroundLine connects contextual conversation feedback, scoped guidance or skill changes, activation, and natural follow-up in its private learning store. Native Codex interprets the original exchanges; Core validates evidence, project boundaries, actual target changes, and observable opportunities without inventing delivery or cost results. Bounded usage audits and direct outcome comparisons provide separate supporting evidence. Three focused skills cover installation, history evidence, and requested workflow improvement. Core stays offline; optional Insights owns consented aggregate upload. Codex owns execution, permissions, model settings, and upgrades.
defaultPrompt: Use $groundline:align-agent-home to install and verify GroundLine while preserving my settings.
Use $groundline:audit-agent-history to inspect bounded usage evidence.
Use $groundline:optimize-codex-workflow to improve scoped guidance from conversation feedback and check natural follow-up.
